proposed_assessment.route: α-Tocopherol / Aβ-challenged differentiated SH-SY5Y metabolic-protection observation
proposed_assessment.disposition: Retain prevention/co-exposure MTT protection and transcript findings; no orthogonal neuronal-function or BUBR1-restoration evidence
proposed_assessment.rationale: After 24 hours of pretreatment and 24 hours of continued exposure with amyloid-beta, 100 and 200 µM alpha-tocopherol improve MTT signal versus injury alone while remaining below uninjured control. No additional benefit at 200 µM is established. No orthogonal quantified survival/death assay or cell-free MTT interference control is reported; this does not prove interference. BUB1B RNA decreases from 192.20 to 162.39 (listed log2 change −0.24; reported q<0.05 selected set), without BUBR1 protein or checkpoint measurement. Stereoisomer, product identity and alpha-tocopherol vehicle remain unspecified. This is not delayed repair, demonstrated autophagic flux, APP processing, neuronal function or MVA rescue.
proposed_assessment.evidence_scope: Complete scientific main, all four tables/captions and native figures, with a bounded independent figure/protocol check; no raw RNA reanalysis.
